notes.title: Type King Update 1.40
notes.content:
Some stuff helping speedrunning as well as general quality of life improvements.

You can now return to language/save slot selection from the main menu. 

Save slots can now be emptied/deleted to start again.

In the Fastest Times window there is now an additional view with the sum of fastest times shown for different categories:
Whole Game (->15 Crowns)
Nightmare (->5 Governors)
Singleplayer (->12 Crowns)
Multiplayer (->3 Crowns)
Singleplayer Easy (->4 Crowns)
Singleplayer Normal (->4 Crowns)
Singleplayer Hard (->4 Crowns)
Singleplayer Nightmare (->4 Governors)

We are also setting up these categories (in addition to each level separately) into speedrun.com so that you people can challenge each other!

notes.title: Type King Update 1.31
notes.content:
Some small changes to help speedrunning!

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
In pause menu you can now Restart floor with R key.

Restart option added to Victory screen.

Fixed a bug where you could open the pause menu after the Victory animation had already started.

notes.title: Type King Localization Update 1.30
notes.content:
With Nightmare difficulty done we have focused on localization. We have just added support for French, German, Spanish and Portuguese!

Type King now supports a total of six languages!

notes.title: Type King Update 1.20
notes.content:
Again smaller stuff while working on the Nightmare Difficulty.

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
Typo King achievement had broken along the way and is now fixed.

Crowns weren't shown correctly in the Main Menu after the game was won.

notes.title: Type King Update 1.19
notes.content:
Mostly smaller stuff while working on the Nightmare Difficulty.

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
Input field was active behind the In-game menu which made typing platforms possible while game was paused.

In rare cases the jumping with arrow keys messed up the input field. This one is tricky. With the fix it's hopefully solid enough that the times it still happens it can be blamed on fickle magic.

Input field not being active/focused. This should be fixed with pausing and resuming the game. Earlier only restarting the game seemed to fix this.

notes.title: Type King Update 1.18
notes.content:
Type King is out now! Continuing with updates as usual. This time some balancing as well.

[h2]1.17[/h2]

[h3]Bigger stuff:[/h3]
Remade the Fastest Times window to look better.

[h2]1.18[/h2]

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
Based on feedback received we made the game modes combining typing and jumping (Type King L, Type King R and Multiplayer) slightly easier. There is now a bit more time before the platforms disintegrate and in the hardest difficulty there are now two checkpoint floors instead of only one (splitting the tower into three segments instead of two).

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
Bug fix to Multiplayer game mode. In rare occurrences similar words were spawning next to each other and only the above one could be typed -> prevented progression.

Story window in Main Menu now opens with a difficulty you have stories unlocked in - instead of always opening with Easy difficulty selected. If Easy stories are unlocked or nothing is unlocked it still opens Easy as default.

notes.title: Type King Update 1.16
notes.content:
Release is coming closer and closer! Here are a few features based on feedback : )

[h3]Bigger stuff:[/h3]
All the game modes can now be restarted from the in-game menu. For Typing Only game mode the restart is for the floor and not the whole level.

Added a menu for showing the fastest times you have beaten different game modes and difficulties in. This only affects victories after this update however so if you had a fast time before it unfortunately won't show there.

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
A small fix to an oversight on how often platforms are remade after falling. Now it works as intended in the previous update.

notes.title: Type King Update 1.15
notes.content:
As before now that there are people already playing I thought I let you guys know what each update includes. We are getting closer and closer to the release!

[h3]Bigger stuff:[/h3]
Tutorial window added at the start of each game mode to show what buttons are used and also some things to note with the game mode chosen. The tutorial texts might get refined in the future but now there is place for them at least.

The floor can now be restarted in Typing game mode from the Pause Menu. No need to wait the time to end if you already know you messed up.

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
Increased the time it takes to make new platforms between falling. Previously the platforms were re-created almost every time you fell but now you should have some time to retry the previous ones.

Small fixes to element locations and achievements.

notes.title: Type King Update 1.14
notes.content:
Since there are already people testing out the Demo and also some people have gotten access to the whole version (via Keymailer) I thought I'd let you guys know about the updates going forward.

[h3]Bigger stuff:[/h3]
New stories for Easy and Normal difficulty in Typing game mode. There was quite some feedback on the Easy difficulty being too long and therefore hard. It is now significantly shorter to match the easier difficulty better.

Highlights in the menu when selecting game modes. This is to better show how the map has a section for each game mode + difficulty. Also making it easier to find which you still haven't won. In the future it may be possible to start the games directly from the map, although that means you'll skip the explanations for them (so maybe after you've beaten some games?)
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145324/c9e3842034eafc3b51f9a3d21c93004e5f203534.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145324/c9e3842034eafc3b51f9a3d21c93004e5f203534.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Smaller stuff:[/h3]
Ctrl+Backspace now removes the last word.

Clarified that in Hard difficulty there are no save codes.

In Typing game mode a pop up will let you know your progress every 25 % as the scepter alone is hard to decipher especially when typing.

Changed the Typing game to show average words per minute (WPM) at the victory screen instead of highest WPM as that could skyrocket if you started out strong and there were a lot of shorter words at the beginning of the floor. Wasn't really giving any valuable information as it was more luck-based.

Fixed some issues in Typing game mode with the characters being left colored even after the input was emptied (for example by pausing the game and returning). There are still some rare cases where the colors are incorrect.
